basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Junior Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Intelligent Cyber Physical Systems at the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati has invited applications for one Junior Project Fellow in the project "Ecohydrology and Vulnerability Assessment in Groundwater-fed and Snow and Glacial-fed River Systems of Western and Eastern Himalaya under the Warming Climate". The total pay is Rs. 28000 (no HRA, no medical) for 3 months. The essential qualification is a Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering with 3 years of experience. Apply online on the IIT Guwahati Recruitment Portal by 4 December 2026; the online interview is on 8

how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati (https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/).
Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.
Find the position by searching for the project title given in the advertisement.
Apply online on or before 4 December 2026.

For technical help with the online application, the notice gives the email [email protected]. For any clarification about the post, it names Prof. Santosha K. Dwivedy (Principal Investigator), email [email protected].
No-objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned employer, for candidates already employed under Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies/Private Organization etc.
important_instructions: No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the test and interview. Applicants must carefully follow the instructions and guidelines on the recruitment portal.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Guwahati
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Research and Development Section of the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Guwahati-781039, Assam. The post sits in the Centre for Intelligent Cyber Physical Systems and serves the Himalayan river ecohydrology project named above.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For the Junior Project Fellow post, the notice asks for a Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering with 3 years of experience. Candidates with equivalent degrees will also be considered, and so will candidates with higher qualifications. The candidate should have knowledge of electrical and electronics fields. The candidate should also be willing to go for field visits for frequent testing of the developed Remotely Operated underwater Vehicles in Himalayan Rivers. Candidates already employed under Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies/Private Organization etc. must submit a No-objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned employer. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification_required: Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering with 3 years of experience; equivalent degrees and higher qualifications will also be considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice prints Pay Recommended of Rs. 28000, HRA as "No", Medical as "No", and a Total Amount of Rs. 28000. The duration of appointment is 3 months.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Junior Project Fellow
content_sections.text: For technical help with the online application, the notice gives the email [email protected] . For any clarification about the post, it names Prof. Santosha K. Dwivedy (Principal Investigator), email [email protected] . Documents named in the notice: No-objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned employer, for candidates already employed under Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies/Private Organization etc.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the interview. The interview is online on 8 December 2026 (Tuesday) at 11:00 AM. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail. The NOC may be submitted in advance or at the time of the interview. Employed candidates who do not submit it will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the test and interview. Applicants must carefully follow the instructions and guidelines on the recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Project Fellow vacancies are there at IIT Guwahati?

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIT Guwahati Junior Project Fellow?
faq.answer: A Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering with 3 years of experience is required. Candidates with equivalent degrees or higher qualifications will also be considered.
